stemMd: Which inference about the higher classification is justified?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It has no possible planning consequences.

options.label: B
options.textMd: It proves the river channel was rebuilt.

options.label: C
options.textMd: It proves a sudden physical change on the map's publication date.

options.label: D
options.textMd: It may reflect improved knowledge of an existing exposure.

options.label: E
options.textMd: It proves the properties cannot flood.

explanationMd: The more precise survey can reveal exposure that already existed. A changed estimate does not itself establish a newly changed physical hazard.

distractorRationale.e: The higher band does not remove risk.
distractorRationale.b: The passage says the channel had not changed.
distractorRationale.c: The passage warns against that inference.
